description:
Use this when the user wants to know which clip to post first, why a clip was picked, or whether a clip is
        ready to post: "which clip should I post first", "why did you pick this one", "review my clip", "is this good
        enough to post", "does it pass the campaign rules". Pass clip_ids (from list_clips, up to 20) or the job_id of a
        finished clip job. Per clip: title, RipClip's score (0-1) and rank within its batch, the reasons it was picked,
        what is said in it (transcript), where it sits in the original video (seconds), its length, the post caption and
        hashtags if RipClip wrote them, a one-line why_it_should_work built only from those facts, and checks: "ok:" or
        "fix:" lines for the hook (silence before the first word), dead air, captions, length and the free plan's
        watermark. For a clipping campaign, read the brief yourself and pass its rules: campaign_min_seconds,
        campaign_max_seconds, must_say (words or names the clip must say), hashtags (required in the post caption).
        The score ranks clips against each other; it is not a forecast of views, so do not present it as one.
        Not for: listing clips (list_clips), watching them (show_clips) or results after posting (get_post_stats,
        why_it_worked). Free and read only.
name: explain_clips
title: Explain clips
